title: Bound required Smoke acceptance jobs and verify the workflow contract

incident_evidence_5736.diagnosis: Smoke acceptance had no job-level timeout-minutes declared in .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml. The job remained running for ~95 minutes until superseded and cancelled by workflow concurrency due to a newer commit push. Without a declared job timeout, GitHub Actions applies the default 360-minute limit.

timing_baseline.metric_source: Recent completed Branch CI Smoke acceptance runs across dev/PR pipeline
timing_baseline.rationale: 30 minutes provides a 2.5x safety buffer above the maximum observed run of 11m36s to prevent false positives from transient runner load, while strictly bounding worst-case step hangs well below GitHub's 360-minute default.

owned: .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml: unconditional 'Verify workflow contract' step running python3 -m unittest scripts.test_branch_ci_gate_selection
scripts/test_branch_ci_gate_selection.py: parse workflow and verify 30-minute timeout, named contract step, unconditional execution, exact command, step order, and preserved step timeouts
